study type: Phased implementation research using mixed methods with a pre-post comparison design.
exposure: integration of a tailored labour companionship model
identification of a female relative as labour companion
provision of information, education and communication materials to women and companions
allowing companions to accompany women throughout the first stage of labour
cohort: The study included women, their labour companions, and healthcare providers across three public hospitals in Egypt, Lebanon, and Syria.
finding: The tailored labour companionship model was found to be feasible, acceptable, effective, and cost-beneficial.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were significantly reduced with the implementation of the labour companionship model.
